data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: key-namespace convention `<skill>:<step>:<purpose>` documented in scratch CLI reference; 5 migration sites (implementation-plan:511, :978, :1238; preplanning:513; sprint:2332) enumerated with authoritative key names

## Description

Create plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md covering:
1. Synopsis of `scratch set / get / clear` and `ticket show --include-scratch` with exit-code contract (get returns exit 0 for both hit and miss; presence is signalled by `status` field).
2. Envelope shape: `{ts:<iso8601>, value:<arbitrary JSON>}`.
3. Key-namespace convention `<skill>:<step>:<purpose>` with rationale (collision avoidance across orchestrator skills).
4. Charset rules and max-byte ceiling (4096 default).
5. Migration site table — exactly 5 rows enumerating: implementation-plan SKILL.md line 511, line 978, line 1238; preplanning SKILL.md line 513; sprint SKILL.md line 2332 — each with the authoritative key name in `<skill>:<step>:<purpose>` form.

Add a one-line link to this doc from plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] Doc enumerates all 5 migration sites with file:line and authoritative key names
  Verify: grep -E 'implementation-plan.*:(511|978|1238)' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md && grep -E 'preplanning.*:513' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md && grep -E 'sprint.*:2332' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md
- [ ] Doc documents `<skill>:<step>:<purpose>` key-namespace convention
  Verify: grep -q '<skill>:<step>:<purpose>' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md
- [ ] Doc documents get hit/miss exit-0 contract
  Verify: grep -qE 'miss.*exit 0|exit 0.*miss' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md
- [ ] ticket-cli-reference.md links to ticket-scratch-cli.md
  Verify: grep -q 'ticket-scratch-cli.md' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md | Create |
| plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md | Edit |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Document scratch CLI + key-namespace convention + 5 migration sites
